data.name: Nanthakumar
data.gender_notes: Nanthakumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nantha means 'Lord' and Kumar means 'of the temple'. Thus, Nanthakumar means 'Lord of the Temple'. The name Nanthakumar carries the meaning “Lord of the Temple” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Nanthakumar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the temple and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nanthakumar is a name that signifies devotion, wisdom, and strength. It is believed that those named Nanthakumar are spiritual leaders, teachers, and guides.
data.etymology: Nanthakumar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Temple.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nanthakumar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

historical_references.reference: Nanthakumar was a prominent Hindu Jain scholar of the 16th century in South India. He authored several works on Jain philosophy and wrote commentaries on the Agamas. Nanthakumar was also a teacher and debater, known for his mastery of Jain scriptures.

Another Nanthakumar, a significant figure in Tamil literature, lived during the early 19th century. He was a poet, scholar, and the last of the great Tamil Sangam poets. His works, known as 'Akam' poems, explore human emotions and relationships. Nanthakumar is also revered as a saint in the Tamil tradition.
